title: Debt relief and remittances can offset foreign aid cuts for most countries, but some remain locked out
abstract: arXiv:2608.21843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In 2025, bilateral foreign aid was reduced by 23%, affecting more than 130 aid recipient countries. We assess whether debt service relief or remittance increases can match the USD 26 billion in aid losses. Using a network-shock model calibrated to bilateral donors' individual cuts, we estimate recipient-country aid losses and evaluate compensation feasibility in terms of annual debt service payments that would need to be cancelled and remittance capacity (the headroom between flows and a theoretical maximum in which every working-age migrant sends funds) mobilised to financially offset them. We find that 18% external debt service relief and 10% of remittance mobilisation could compensate half of the affected countries. However, some countries remain locked out of either or both mechanisms. A fundamental trade-off in the global financial architecture emerged for large aid-cut losers: countries positioned to benefit from debt service relie

translated_title: 债务减免和汇款可以抵消大多数国家的外援削减，但一些国家仍被排除在外
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21843v1 公告类型：新 摘要：2025年，双边外援减少了23%，影响了超过130个受援国。我们评估了债务服务减免或汇款增加是否能弥补260亿美元的援助损失。使用一个校准到双边捐助者个体削减的网络冲击模型，我们估算了受援国的援助损失，并评估了补偿可行性，即需要取消的年度债务服务支付和汇款能力（流量与理论最大值之间的余量，其中每个工作年龄移民都汇款）来财务抵消这些损失。我们发现，18%的外部债务服务减免和10%的汇款动员可以补偿一半受影响的国家的损失。然而，一些国家仍被排除在这两种机制之外或其中一种之外。全球金融架构中出现了针对大规模援助削减损失者的根本性权衡：那些有资格从债务服务减免中受益的国家，与那些依赖汇款的国家之间存在冲突。
tldr: 本文通过模型评估发现，债务减免和汇款增加可补偿半数受援国的外援削减损失，但部分国家因结构性限制无法受益，揭示了全球金融架构中的根本性权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper models that debt relief and remittance increases can offset aid cuts for half of affected countries, but some remain excluded due to structural constraints, revealing a fundamental trade-off in the global financial architecture.
